coachView.name: DynamicReportGrid
coachView.layout:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><ns2:layout xmlns:ns2="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/CoachDesignerNG" xmlns:ns3="http://www.ibm.com/bpm/coachview"><ns2:layoutItem xsi:type="ns2:CustomHTML" version="8550" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><ns2:id>1f5c6d9d-d406-4c77-9ec3-200cc8cfc39c</ns2:id><ns2:layoutItemId>CustomHTML1</ns2:layoutItemId><ns2:configData><ns2:id>0909a029-9bc2-42e9-bc29-a9229ccb66c7</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.contentType</ns2:optionName><ns2:value>TEXT</ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:configData><ns2:id>b2d9fba2-fd25-4f5b-8d92-a61b43b168cd</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.textContent</ns2:optionName><ns2:value><div class="dynamic-report-grid" role="region" aria-label="Dynamic data grid">
  <!-- Loading Overlay -->
  <div class="grid-loading-overlay" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="grid-loading-spinner"></div>
    <div class="grid-loading-text">Loading data...</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Error Message -->
  <div class="grid-error-message" role="alert" aria-live="assertive" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg class="grid-error-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
      <path d="M8 1C4.1 1 1 4.1 1 8s3.1 7 7 7 7-3.1 7-7-3.1-7-7-7zm-.5 3h1v5h-1V4zm.5 7.5c-.4 0-.8-.3-.8-.8s.3-.8.8-.8.8.3.8.8-.4.8-.8.8z"/>
    </svg>
    <span class="grid-error-text">Error loading data</span>
  </div>

  <!-- Grid Controls -->
  <div class="grid-controls">
    <div class="grid-info" aria-live="polite">
      <span class="grid-showing-text">Showing 0-0 of 0 rows</span>
    </div>
    <div class="grid-page-size-selector">
      <label for="grid-page-size" class="grid-label">Rows per page:</label>
      <select id="grid-page-size" class="grid-page-size-select" aria-label="Select rows per page">
        <option value="10">10</option>
        <option value="25" selected>25</option>
        <option value="50">50</option>
        <option value="100">100</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Data Grid Table -->
  <div class="grid-table-wrapper" role="region" aria-label="Data table" tabindex="0">
    <table class="grid-table" role="table">
      <thead role="rowgroup">
        <tr role="row" class="grid-header-row">
          <!-- Column headers will be dynamically generated -->
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody role="rowgroup" class="grid-body">
        <!-- Data rows will be dynamically generated -->
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <!-- No Data Message -->
  <div class="grid-no-data" role="status" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg class="grid-no-data-icon" width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="currentColor">
      <path d="M16 2C8.3 2 2 8.3 2 16s6.3 14 14 14 14-6.3 14-14S23.7 2 16 2zm0 26C9.4 28 4 22.6 4 16S9.4 4 16 4s12 5.4 12 12-5.4 12-12 12z"/>
      <path d="M16 8c-.6 0-1 .4-1 1v8c0 .6.4 1 1 1s1-.4 1-1V9c0-.6-.4-1-1-1z"/>
    </svg>
    <div class="grid-no-data-text">No data available</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Pagination Controls -->
  <div class="grid-pagination" role="navigation" aria-label="Pagination">
    <div class="grid-page-info" aria-live="polite">
      <span class="grid-page-text">Page 1 of 1</span>
    </div>
    <div class="grid-pagination-buttons">
      <button 
        type="button" 
        class="grid-btn grid-btn-first" 
        aria-label="Go to first page"
        disabled>
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
          <path d="M11 8L6 3v10l5-5zM5 3H4v10h1V3z"/>
        </svg>
      </button>
      <button 
        type="button" 
        class="grid-btn grid-btn-prev" 
        aria-label="Go to previous page"
        disabled>
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
          <path d="M10 13L5 8l5-5v10z"/>
        </svg>
      </button>
      <button 
        type="button" 
        class="grid-btn grid-btn-next" 
        aria-label="Go to next page"
        disabled>
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
          <path d="M6 3l5 5-5 5V3z"/>
        </svg>
      </button>
      <button 
        type="button" 
        class="grid-btn grid-btn-last" 
        aria-label="Go to last page"
        disabled>
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
          <path d="M5 8l5 5V3L5 8zM11 3h1v10h-1V3z"/>
        </svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div></ns2:value></ns2:configData></ns2:layoutItem></ns2:layout>
coachView.description: Production-ready server-side paginated data grid with dynamic configuration, SQL template support, and zero client-side data caching for IBM Business Automation Workflow

configOption.name: columns
configOption.label: Column Definitions
configOption.description: Array of column definitions with field names, labels, types, and formatters

configOption.name: pageSize
configOption.label: Initial Page Size
configOption.description: Initial number of rows per page (10, 25, 50, or 100)

configOption.name: pageSizeOptions
configOption.label: Page Size Options
configOption.description: Available page size options for user selection

configOption.name: defaultSortColumn
configOption.label: Default Sort Column
configOption.description: Column field name to sort by default

configOption.name: defaultSortDirection
configOption.label: Default Sort Direction
configOption.description: Default sort direction: ASC or DESC

configOption.name: size
configOption.label: Grid Size
configOption.description: Grid sizing mode: small, medium, or large

configOption.name: showStatusColumn
configOption.label: Show Status Column
configOption.description: Display status indicators with color-coded badges

configOption.name: statusColumnField
configOption.label: Status Column Field
configOption.description: Field name containing status values (success, warning, error, info)

configOption.name: loadingText
configOption.label: Loading Text
configOption.description: Text displayed during data fetch operations

configOption.name: noDataText
configOption.label: No Data Text
configOption.description: Text displayed when no results are found

configOption.name: autoRefresh
configOption.label: Auto Refresh on Events
configOption.description: Automatically trigger data refresh when pagination/sort events fire
